method.source_hash: Sorted unique existing git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard paths: .rs/.sql/.json and Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/rust-toolchain.toml; SHA-256 over path UTF-8, NUL, file bytes, NUL. Report created afterward.
method.execution_timer: start through wait; final equality, retained-byte accounting and RunId set checks follow the timer and are included in throughput
method.rss: Whole-process peak RSS in bytes from macOS /usr/bin/time -l
method.retained_bytes: max_retained_data_bytes is the maximum final RunSnapshot size observed, not the peak within a run
method.simulated_latency: Exactly one first operation sleeps for 10 ms; includes Tokio timer/scheduling and is not a real network
method.revision_change: Revision 1 adds verbose warmup failure diagnostics and state/error_code to the measurement Sample. Engine and budgets unchanged.

calibration.explanation: Initial rejection expectation was incorrect: confirmed node inputs are cleared. The measurement refused to publish this invalid combination; the completed matrix measures it as a success.
